Writing Functions

``` r
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
```

``` r
library(readxl)
```

## Functions!

Start small with Z scores.

``` r
x_vec = rnorm(n = 40, mean = 12, sd = 63)

(x_vec - mean(x_vec)) / sd(x_vec)
```

    ##  [1]  0.172772657  2.466295104  0.312245492 -1.611124264  0.111793490
    ##  [6]  0.002031818  0.478024043  1.475121859 -0.509134816  0.302244311
    ## [11] -1.143754588 -0.049956511  1.083351892 -1.336692812 -0.971108891
    ## [16]  0.180313249  0.037194764  0.730970902 -1.131685723  0.810069684
    ## [21] -1.006759133  0.088535153 -0.473797596  1.333807196  1.249833595
    ## [26]  0.944867043  0.169213318  0.158297769 -0.580769043  0.417233472
    ## [31]  0.353921712 -0.438615309  0.767074263 -2.415277459 -1.262860222
    ## [36] -1.783521730  1.009157903 -0.725932886  0.775735760  0.010884536

Let’s turn this into a function

``` r
z_scores = function(x) {
  
  if (!is.numeric(x)) {
    stop("Input x must be numeric")
  } else if (length(x) < 5) {
    stop("x should have 5 or more numbers")
  }
  
  z = (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)
  
  return(z)
  
}
```

Does this actually work???

``` r
z_scores(x_vec)
```
